verdict.rationale: Wave is a small-business accounting SaaS, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no MCP server: Wave's public pages document no API, MCP, CLI, or webhook surface. A live GraphQL endpoint is only a developer building block and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
